1.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses in tha wilderness of Sinai, in tha tabernacle of tha congregation, on tha first day of tha second month, in tha second year after dey were come out of tha land of Egypt, sayin,
Take y’all tha sum of all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, after their families, by tha house of their fathers, wit tha number of their namez, every male by their polls;
From twenty years old N upward, all dat r able 2 go forth 2 war in Israel: u N Aaron shall number ’em by their armies.
N wit u there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of tha house of his fathers.
N dese r tha namez of tha men dat shall stand wit u: of tha tribe of Reuben; Elizur tha son of Shedeur.
Of Simeon; Shelumiel tha son of Zurishaddai.
Of Judah; Nahshon tha son of Amminadab.
Of Issachar; Nethaneel tha son of Zuar.
Of Zebulun; Eliab tha son of Helon.
Of tha children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama tha son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel tha son of Pedahzur.
Of Benjamin; Abidan tha son of Gideoni.
Of Dan; Ahiezer tha son of Ammishaddai.
Of Asher; Pagiel tha son of Ocran.
Of Gad; Eliasaph tha son of Deuel.
Of Naphtali; Ahira tha son of Enan.
Dese were tha renowned of tha congregation, princes of tha tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
N Moses N Aaron took dese men which r expressed by their namez:

N dey assembled all tha congregation together on tha first day of tha second month, N dey declared their pedigrees after their families, by tha house of their fathers, according 2 tha number of tha namez, from twenty years old N upward, by their polls.
As tha LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered ’em in tha wilderness of Sinai.

N tha children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by tha house of their fathers, according 2 tha number of tha namez, by their polls, every male from twenty years old N upward, all dat were able 2 go forth 2 war;
Dose dat were numbered of ’em, even of tha tribe of Reuben, were forty N six thousand N five hundred.

Of tha children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by tha house of their fathers, dose dat were numbered of ’em, according 2 tha number of tha namez, by their polls, every male from twenty years old N upward, all dat were able 2 go forth 2 war;

Of tha children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by tha house of their fathers, according 2 tha number of tha namez, from twenty years old N upward, all dat were able 2 go forth 2 war;
Dose dat were numbered of ’em, even of tha tribe of Zebulun, were fifty N seven thousand N four hundred.

Of tha children of Joseph, namely, of tha children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by tha house of their fathers, according 2 tha number of tha namez, from twenty years old N upward, all dat were able 2 go forth 2 war;

So were all dose dat were numbered of tha children of Israel, by tha house of their fathers, from twenty years old N upward, all dat were able 2 go forth 2 war in Israel;

But tha Levites after tha tribe of their fathers were not numbered among ’em.
4 tha LORD had spoken 2 Moses, sayin,
Only u will not number tha tribe of Levi, neither take tha sum of ’em among tha children of Israel:

But u will appoint tha Levites over tha tabernacle of testimony, N over all tha vessels of it, N over all things dat belong 2 it: dey shall bear tha tabernacle, N all tha vessels of it; N dey shall minister 2 it, N shall encamp round about tha tabernacle.

2.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,

N his host, N dose dat were numbered of it, were fifty N seven thousand N four hundred.
All dat were numbered in tha camp of Judah were an hundred thousand N fourscore thousand N six thousand N four hundred, throughout their armies. dese shall first set forth.
On tha south side shall be tha standard of tha camp of Reuben according 2 their armies: N tha captain of tha children of Reuben shall be Elizur tha son of Shedeur.

Then tha tribe of Gad: N tha captain of tha sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph tha son of Reuel.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were forty N five thousand N six hundred N fifty.
All dat were numbered in tha camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand N fifty N one thousand N four hundred N fifty, throughout their armies. N dey shall set forth in tha second rank.
Then tha tabernacle of tha congregation shall set forward wit tha camp of tha Levites in tha midst of tha camp: as dey encamp, so shall dey set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
On tha west side shall be tha standard of tha camp of Ephraim according 2 their armies: N tha captain of tha sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama tha son of Ammihud.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were forty thousand N five hundred.
N by him shall be tha tribe of Manasseh: N tha captain of tha children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel tha son of Pedahzur.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were thirty N two thousand N two hundred.
Then tha tribe of Benjamin: N tha captain of tha sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan tha son of Gideoni.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were thirty N five thousand N four hundred.
All dat were numbered of tha camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand N eight thousand N an hundred, throughout their armies. N dey shall go forward in tha third rank.
Tha standard of tha camp of Dan shall be on tha north side by their armies: N tha captain of tha children of Dan shall be Ahiezer tha son of Ammishaddai.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were threescore N two thousand N seven hundred.
N dose dat encamp by him shall be tha tribe of Asher: N tha captain of tha children of Asher shall be Pagiel tha son of Ocran.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were forty N one thousand N five hundred.
Then tha tribe of Naphtali: N tha captain of tha children of Naphtali shall be Ahira tha son of Enan.
N his host, N dose dat were numbered of ’em, were fifty N three thousand N four hundred.
All dey dat were numbered in tha camp of Dan were an hundred thousand N fifty N seven thousand N six hundred. dey shall go hindmost wit their standards.

Dese r dose which were numbered of tha children of Israel by tha house of their fathers: all dose dat were numbered of tha camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand N three thousand N five hundred N fifty.
But tha Levites were not numbered among tha children of Israel; as tha LORD commanded Moses.

N tha children of Israel did according 2 all dat tha LORD commanded Moses: so dey pitched by their standards, N so dey set forward, every one after their families, according 2 tha house of their fathers.

3.text: Dese also r tha generations of Aaron N Moses in tha day dat tha LORD spoke wit Moses in mount Sinai.
N dese r tha namez of tha sons of Aaron; Nadab tha firstborn, N Abihu, Eleazar, N Ithamar.

N Nadab N Abihu died before tha LORD, when dey offered strange fire before tha LORD, in tha wilderness of Sinai, N dey had no children: N Eleazar N Ithamar ministered in tha priest’s office in tha sight of Aaron their father.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Bring tha tribe of Levi near, N present ’em before Aaron tha priest, dat dey may minister 2 him.
N dey shall keep his charge, N tha charge of tha whole congregation before tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle.
N dey shall keep all tha instruments of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N tha charge of tha children of Israel, 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle.
N u will give tha Levites 2 Aaron N 2 his sons: dey r wholly given 2 him out of tha children of Israel.
N u will appoint Aaron N his sons, N dey shall wait on their priest’s office: N tha stranger dat comes nigh shall be put 2 death.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
N I, look, I have taken tha Levites from among tha children of Israel instead of all tha firstborn dat opens tha matrix among tha children of Israel: therefore tha Levites shall be mine;
Because all tha firstborn r mine; 4 on tha day dat I struck all tha firstborn in tha land of Egypt I hallowed 2 me all tha firstborn in Israel, both man N beast: mine shall dey be: I am tha LORD.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses in tha wilderness of Sinai, sayin,
Number tha children of Levi after tha house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old N upward will u number ’em.
N Moses numbered ’em according 2 tha word of tha LORD, as he was commanded.
N dese were tha sons of Levi by their namez; Gershon, N Kohath, N Merari.
N dese r tha namez of tha sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, N Shimei.
N tha sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, N Izehar, Hebron, N Uzziel.
N tha sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, N Mushi. dese r tha families of tha Levites according 2 tha house of their fathers.
Of Gershon was tha family of tha Libnites, N tha family of tha Shimites: dese r tha families of tha Gershonites.
Dose dat were numbered of ’em, according 2 tha number of all tha males, from a month old N upward, even dose dat were numbered of ’em were seven thousand N five hundred.
Tha families of tha Gershonites shall pitch behind tha tabernacle westward.
N tha chief of tha house of tha father of tha Gershonites shall be Eliasaph tha son of Lael.
N tha charge of tha sons of Gershon in tha tabernacle of tha congregation shall be tha tabernacle, N tha tent, tha covering of it, N tha hanging 4 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation,
N tha hangings of tha court, N tha curtain 4 tha door of tha court, which is by tha tabernacle, N by tha altar round about, N tha cords of it 4 all tha service of it.
N of Kohath was tha family of tha Amramites, N tha family of tha Izeharites, N tha family of tha Hebronites, N tha family of tha Uzzielites: dese r tha families of tha Kohathites.
In tha number of all tha males, from a month old N upward, were eight thousand N six hundred, keepin tha charge of tha sanctuary.
Tha families of tha sons of Kohath shall pitch on tha side of tha tabernacle southward.
N tha chief of tha house of tha father of tha families of tha Kohathites shall be Elizaphan tha son of Uzziel.
N their charge shall be tha ark, N tha table, N tha candlestick, N tha altars, N tha vessels of tha sanctuary wherewith dey minister, N tha hanging, N all tha service of it.
N Eleazar tha son of Aaron tha priest shall be chief over tha chief of tha Levites, N have tha oversight of ’em dat keep tha charge of tha sanctuary.
Of Merari was tha family of tha Mahlites, N tha family of tha Mushites: dese r tha families of Merari.
N dose dat were numbered of ’em, according 2 tha number of all tha males, from a month old N upward, were six thousand N two hundred.
N tha chief of tha house of tha father of tha families of Merari was Zuriel tha son of Abihail: dese shall pitch on tha side of tha tabernacle northward.

N under tha custody N charge of tha sons of Merari shall be tha boards of tha tabernacle, N tha bars of it, N tha pillars of it, N tha sockets of it, N all tha vessels of it, N all dat serves thereto,
N tha pillars of tha court round about, N their sockets, N their pins, N their cords.

But dose dat encamp before tha tabernacle toward tha east, even before tha tabernacle of tha congregation eastward, shall be Moses, N Aaron N his sons, keepin tha charge of tha sanctuary 4 tha charge of tha children of Israel; N tha stranger dat comes nigh shall be put 2 death.
All dat were numbered of tha Levites, which Moses N Aaron numbered at tha commandment of tha LORD, throughout their families, all tha males from a month old N upward, were twenty N two thousand.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Number all tha firstborn of tha males of tha children of Israel from a month old N upward, N take tha number of their namez.

N u will take tha Levites 4 me (I am tha LORD ) instead of all tha firstborn among tha children of Israel; N tha cattle of tha Levites instead of all tha firstlings among tha cattle of tha children of Israel.

N all tha firstborn males by tha number of namez, from a month old N upward, of dose dat were numbered of ’em, were twenty N two thousand two hundred N threescore N thirteen.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Take tha Levites instead of all tha firstborn among tha children of Israel, N tha cattle of tha Levites instead of their cattle; N tha Levites shall be mine: I am tha LORD.
N 4 dose dat r 2 be redeemed of tha two hundred N threescore N thirteen of tha firstborn of tha children of Israel, which r more than tha Levites;
u will even take five shekels apiece by tha poll, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary will u take ’em: (tha shekel is twenty gerahs:)

N Moses took tha redemption money of ’em dat were over N above ’em dat were redeemed by tha Levites:
Of tha firstborn of tha children of Israel took he tha money; a thousand three hundred N threescore N five shekels, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary:
N Moses gave tha money of ’em dat were redeemed 2 Aaron N 2 his sons, according 2 tha word of tha LORD, as tha LORD commanded Moses.

4.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,

N upon tha table of showbread dey shall spread a cloth of blue, N put thereon tha dishes, N tha spoons, N tha bowls, N covers 2 cover withal: N tha continual bread shall be thereon:

N dey shall take a cloth of blue, N cover tha candlestick of tha light, N his lamps, N his tongs, N his snuffdishes, N all tha oil vessels of it, wherewith dey minister 2 it:

N dey shall take all tha instruments of ministry, wherewith dey minister in tha sanctuary, N put ’em in a cloth of blue, N cover ’em wit a covering of badgers’ skins, N shall put ’em on a bar:
N dey shall take away tha ashes from tha altar, N spread a purple cloth thereon:

N dey shall put upon it all tha vessels of it, wherewith dey minister about it, even tha censers, tha fleshhooks, N tha shovels, N tha basons, all tha vessels of tha altar; N dey shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, N put 2 tha staves of it.

N when Aaron N his sons have made an end of covering tha sanctuary, N all tha vessels of tha sanctuary, as tha camp is 2 set forward; after dat, tha sons of Kohath shall come 2 bear it: but dey shall not touch any holy thing, lest dey die. dese things r tha burden of tha sons of Kohath in tha tabernacle of tha congregation.

N 2 tha office of Eleazar tha son of Aaron tha priest pertains tha oil 4 tha light, N tha sweet incense, N tha daily food offering, N tha anointing oil, N tha oversight of all tha tabernacle, N of all dat in it is, in tha sanctuary, N in tha vessels of it.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
Cut y’all not off tha tribe of tha families of tha Kohathites from among tha Levites:
But like dis do 2 ’em, dat dey may live, N not die, when dey approach 2 tha most holy things: Aaron N his sons shall go in, N appoint ’em every one 2 his service N 2 his burden:
But dey shall not go in 2 see when tha holy things r covered, lest dey die.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Take also tha sum of tha sons of Gershon, throughout tha houses of their fathers, by their families;
From thirty years old N upward until fifty years old will u number ’em; all dat enter in 2 perform tha service, 2 do tha work in tha tabernacle of tha congregation.

N tha hangings of tha court, N tha hanging 4 tha door of tha gate of tha court, which is by tha tabernacle N by tha altar round about, N their cords, N all tha instruments of their service, N all dat is made 4 ’em: so shall dey serve.

N dis is tha charge of their burden, according 2 all their service in tha tabernacle of tha congregation; tha boards of tha tabernacle, N tha bars of it, N tha pillars of it, N sockets of it,

N tha pillars of tha court round about, N their sockets, N their pins, N their cords, wit all their instruments, N wit all their service: N by name y’all shall reckon tha instruments of tha charge of their burden.

N Moses N Aaron N tha chief of tha congregation numbered tha sons of tha Kohathites after their families, N after tha house of their fathers,
From thirty years old N upward even 2 fifty years old, every one dat enters in2 tha service, 4 tha work in tha tabernacle of tha congregation:
N dose dat were numbered of ’em by their families were two thousand seven hundred N fifty.

5.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Command tha children of Israel, dat dey put out of tha camp every leper, N every one dat has an issue, N whoever is defiled by tha dead:

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Then dey shall confess their sin which dey have done: N he shall recompense his trespass wit tha principal of it, N add 2 it tha fifth part of it, N give it 2 him against whom he has trespassed.
But if tha man have no kinsman 2 recompense tha trespass 2, let tha trespass be recompensed 2 tha LORD, even 2 tha priest; beside tha ram of tha atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made 4 him.
N every offering of all tha holy things of tha children of Israel, which dey bring 2 tha priest, shall be his.

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, If any man’s wife go aside, N commit a trespass against him,
N a man lie wit her carnally, N it be hid from tha eyes of her husband, N be kept close, N she be defiled, N there be no witness against her, neither she be taken wit tha manner;
N tha spirit of jealousy come upon him, N he be jealous of his wife, N she be defiled: or if tha spirit of jealousy come upon him, N he be jealous of his wife, N she don’t be defiled:

Then shall tha man bring his wife 2 tha priest, N he shall bring her offering 4 her, tha tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; 4 it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringin iniquity 2 remembrance.
N tha priest shall bring her near, N set her before tha LORD:
N tha priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; N of tha dust dat is in tha floor of tha tabernacle tha priest shall take, N put it in2 tha water:

N tha priest shall set tha woman before tha LORD, N uncover tha woman’s head, N put tha offering of memorial in her hands, which is tha jealousy offering: N tha priest shall have in his hand tha bitter water dat causes tha curse:

N tha priest shall charge her by an oath, N say 2 tha woman, If no man have lain wit u, N if u have not gone aside 2 uncleanness wit another instead of ur husband, be u free from dis bitter water dat causes tha curse:
But if u have gone aside 2 another instead of ur husband, N if u be defiled, N some man have lain wit u beside thine husband:

Then tha priest shall charge tha woman wit an oath of cursing, N tha priest shall say 2 tha woman, tha LORD make u a curse N an oath among ur people, when tha LORD does make ur thigh 2 rot, N ur belly 2 swell;
N dis water dat causes tha curse shall go in2 ur bowels, 2 make ur belly 2 swell, N ur thigh 2 rot: N tha woman shall say, Amen, amen.
N tha priest shall write dese curses in a book, N he shall blot ’em out wit tha bitter water:
N he shall cause tha woman 2 drink tha bitter water dat causes tha curse: N tha water dat causes tha curse shall enter in2 her, N become bitter.
Then tha priest shall take tha jealousy offering out of tha woman’s hand, N shall wave tha offering before tha LORD, N offer it upon tha altar:
N tha priest shall take an handful of tha offering, even tha memorial of it, N burn it upon tha altar, N afterward shall cause tha woman 2 drink tha water.

N when he has made her 2 drink tha water, then it will happen, dat, if she be defiled, N have done trespass against her husband, dat tha water dat causes tha curse shall enter in2 her, N become bitter, N her belly shall swell, N her thigh shall rot: N tha woman shall be a curse among her people.
N if tha woman don’t be defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, N shall conceive seed.
Dis is tha law of jealousies, when a wife goes aside 2 another instead of her husband, N is defiled;
Or when tha spirit of jealousy comes upon him, N he be jealous over his wife, N shall set tha woman before tha LORD, N tha priest shall execute upon her all dis law.
Then shall tha man be guiltless from iniquity, N dis woman shall bear her iniquity.

6.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When either man or woman shall separate themselves 2 vow a vow of a Nazarite, 2 separate themselves 2 tha LORD:
He shall separate himself from wine N strong drink, N shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
All tha days of his separation shall he eat nothing dat is made of tha vine tree, from tha kernels even 2 tha husk.

All tha days of tha vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until tha days be fulfilled, in tha which he separateth himself 2 tha LORD, he shall be holy, N shall let tha locks of tha hair of his head grow.
All tha days dat he separateth himself 2 tha LORD he shall come at no dead body.
He shall not make himself unclean 4 his father, or 4 his mother, 4 his brother, or 4 his sister, when dey die: because tha consecration of his God is upon his head.
All tha days of his separation he is holy 2 tha LORD.
N if any man die very suddenly by him, N he has defiled tha head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in tha day of his cleansing, on tha seventh day shall he shave it.
N on tha eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, 2 tha priest, 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation:
N tha priest shall offer tha one 4 a sin offering, N tha other 4 a burnt offering, N make an atonement 4 him, 4 dat he sinned by tha dead, N shall hallow his head dat same day.

N he shall consecrate 2 tha LORD tha days of his separation, N shall bring a lamb of tha first year 4 a trespass offering: but tha days dat were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
N dis is tha law of tha Nazarite, when tha days of his separation r fulfilled: he shall be brought 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation:

N he shall offer his offering 2 tha LORD, one he lamb of tha first year without blemish 4 a burnt offering, N one ewe lamb of tha first year without blemish 4 a sin offering, N one ram without blemish 4 peace offerings,
N a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled wit oil, N wafers of unleavened bread anointed wit oil, N their food offering, N their drink offerings.
N tha priest shall bring ’em before tha LORD, N shall offer his sin offering, N his burnt offering:
N he shall offer tha ram 4 a sacrifice of peace offerings 2 tha LORD, wit tha basket of unleavened bread: tha priest shall offer also his food offering, N his drink offering.

N tha Nazarite shall shave tha head of his separation at tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N shall take tha hair of tha head of his separation, N put it in tha fire which is under tha sacrifice of tha peace offerings.

N tha priest shall take tha sodden shoulder of tha ram, N one unleavened cake out of tha basket, N one unleavened wafer, N shall put ’em upon tha hands of tha Nazarite, after tha hair of his separation is shaven:
N tha priest shall wave ’em 4 a wave offering before tha LORD: dis is holy 4 tha priest, wit tha wave breast N heave shoulder: N after dat tha Nazarite may drink wine.

Dis is tha law of tha Nazarite who has vowed, N of his offering 2 tha LORD 4 his separation, beside dat dat his hand shall get: according 2 tha vow which he vowed, so he must do after tha law of his separation.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Aaron N 2 his sons, sayin, On dis wise y’all shall bless tha children of Israel, sayin 2 ’em,
Tha LORD bless u, N keep u:
Tha LORD make his face shine upon u, N be gracious 2 u:
Tha LORD lift up his countenance upon u, N give u peace.
N dey shall put my name upon tha children of Israel; N I will bless ’em.

7.text: N it happened on tha day dat Moses had fully set up tha tabernacle, N had anointed it, N sanctified it, N all tha instruments of it, both tha altar N all tha vessels of it, N had anointed ’em, N sanctified ’em;
Dat tha princes of Israel, heads of tha house of their fathers, who were tha princes of tha tribes, N were over ’em dat were numbered, offered:
N dey brought their offering before tha LORD, six covered wagons, N twelve oxen; a wagon 4 two of tha princes, N 4 each one an ox: N dey brought ’em before tha tabernacle.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Take it of ’em, dat dey may be 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation; N u will give ’em 2 tha Levites, 2 every man according 2 his service.
N Moses took tha wagons N tha oxen, N gave ’em 2 tha Levites.
Two wagons N four oxen he gave 2 tha sons of Gershon, according 2 their service:
N four wagons N eight oxen he gave 2 tha sons of Merari, according 2 their service, under tha hand of Ithamar tha son of Aaron tha priest.
But 2 tha sons of Kohath he gave none: because tha service of tha sanctuary belonging 2 ’em was dat dey should bear upon their shoulders.
N tha princes offered 4 dedicating of tha altar in tha day dat it was anointed, even tha princes offered their offering before tha altar.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, dey shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, 4 tha dedicating of tha altar.
N he dat offered his offering tha first day was Nahshon tha son of Amminadab, of tha tribe of Judah:

N his offering was one silver charger, tha weight of it was an hundred N thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary; both of ’em were full of fine flour mingled wit oil 4 a food offering:
One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of tha first year, 4 a burnt offering:
One kid of tha goats 4 a sin offering:
N 4 a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of tha first year: dis was tha offering of Nahshon tha son of Amminadab.
On tha second day Nethaneel tha son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

He offered 4 his offering one silver charger, tha weight whereof was an hundred N thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary; both of ’em full of fine flour mingled wit oil 4 a food offering:
One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:

On tha third day Eliab tha son of Helon, prince of tha children of Zebulun, did offer:

One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of tha first year, 4 a burnt offering:

One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of tha first year, 4 a burnt offering:

N 4 a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of tha first year: dis was tha offering of Elizur tha son of Shedeur.

On tha twelfth day Ahira tha son of Enan, prince of tha children of Naphtali, offered:
