Dis was tha dedication of tha altar, in tha day when it was anointed, by tha princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
Each charger of silver weighing an hundred N thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all tha silver vessels weighed two thousand N four hundred shekels, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary:
Tha golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary: all tha gold of tha spoons was an hundred N twenty shekels.
All tha oxen 4 tha burnt offering were twelve bullocks, tha rams twelve, tha lambs of tha first year twelve, wit their food offering: N tha kids of tha goats 4 sin offering twelve.

N all tha oxen 4 tha sacrifice of tha peace offerings were twenty N four bullocks, tha rams sixty, tha he goats sixty, tha lambs of tha first year sixty. dis was tha dedication of tha altar, after dat it was anointed.

N when Moses was gone in2 tha tabernacle of tha congregation 2 speak wit him, then he heard tha voice of one speakin 2 him from off tha mercy seat dat was upon tha ark of testimony, from between tha two cherubims: N he spoke 2 him.

8.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Aaron, N say 2 him, When u lightest tha lamps, tha seven lamps shall give light over against tha candlestick.
N Aaron did so; he lighted tha lamps of it over against tha candlestick, as tha LORD commanded Moses.
N dis work of tha candlestick was of beaten gold, 2 tha shaft of it, 2 tha flowers of it, was beaten work: according 2 tha pattern which tha LORD had showed Moses, so he made tha candlestick.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Take tha Levites from among tha children of Israel, N cleanse ’em.
N like dis will u do 2 ’em, 2 cleanse ’em: Sprinkle water of purifying upon ’em, N let ’em shave all their flesh, N let ’em wash their clothes, N so make themselves clean.
Then let ’em take a young bullock wit his food offering, even fine flour mingled wit oil, N another young bullock will u take 4 a sin offering.
N u will bring tha Levites before tha tabernacle of tha congregation: N u will gather tha whole assembly of tha children of Israel together:
N u will bring tha Levites before tha LORD: N tha children of Israel shall put their hands upon tha Levites:
N Aaron shall offer tha Levites before tha LORD 4 an offering of tha children of Israel, dat dey may execute tha service of tha LORD.
N tha Levites shall lay their hands upon tha heads of tha bullocks: N u will offer tha one 4 a sin offering, N tha other 4 a burnt offering, 2 tha LORD, 2 make an atonement 4 tha Levites.
N u will set tha Levites before Aaron, N before his sons, N offer ’em 4 an offering 2 tha LORD.
Like dis will u separate tha Levites from among tha children of Israel: N tha Levites shall be mine.
N after dat shall tha Levites go in 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation: N u will cleanse ’em, N offer ’em 4 an offering.
4 dey r wholly given 2 me from among tha children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of tha firstborn of all tha children of Israel, have I taken ’em 2 me.
4 all tha firstborn of tha children of Israel r mine, both man N beast: on tha day dat I struck every firstborn in tha land of Egypt I sanctified ’em 4 myself.
N I have taken tha Levites 4 all tha firstborn of tha children of Israel.

N I have given tha Levites as a gift 2 Aaron N 2 his sons from among tha children of Israel, 2 do tha service of tha children of Israel in tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N 2 make an atonement 4 tha children of Israel: dat there be no plague among tha children of Israel, when tha children of Israel come nigh 2 tha sanctuary.
N Moses, N Aaron, N all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, did 2 tha Levites according 2 all dat tha LORD commanded Moses concerning tha Levites, so did tha children of Israel 2 ’em.
N tha Levites were purified, N dey washed their clothes; N Aaron offered ’em as an offering before tha LORD; N Aaron made an atonement 4 ’em 2 cleanse ’em.
N after dat went tha Levites in 2 do their service in tha tabernacle of tha congregation before Aaron, N before his sons: as tha LORD had commanded Moses concerning tha Levites, so did dey 2 ’em.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Dis is it dat belongs 2 tha Levites: from twenty N five years old N upward dey shall go in 2 wait upon tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation:
N from tha age of fifty years dey shall cease waitin upon tha service of it, N shall serve no more:
But shall minister wit their brothers in tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 2 keep tha charge, N shall do no service. like dis will u do 2 tha Levites touching their charge.

9.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses in tha wilderness of Sinai, in tha first month of tha second year after dey were come out of tha land of Egypt, sayin,
Let tha children of Israel also keep tha passover at his appointed season.
In tha fourteenth day of dis month, at even, y’all shall keep it in his appointed season: according 2 all tha rites of it, N according 2 all tha ceremonies of it, shall y’all keep it.
N Moses spoke 2 tha children of Israel, dat dey should keep tha passover.
N dey kept tha passover on tha fourteenth day of tha first month at even in tha wilderness of Sinai: according 2 all dat tha LORD commanded Moses, so did tha children of Israel.
N there were certain men, who were defiled by tha dead body of a man, dat dey could not keep tha passover on dat day: N dey came before Moses N before Aaron on dat day:
N dose men said 2 him, We r defiled by tha dead body of a man: so r we kept back, dat we may not offer an offering of tha LORD in his appointed season among tha children of Israel?
N Moses said 2 ’em, Stand still, N I will hear what tha LORD will command concerning u.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, If any man of u or of ur posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep tha passover 2 tha LORD.
Tha fourteenth day of tha second month at even dey shall keep it, N eat it wit unleavened bread N bitter herbs.
Dey shall leave none of it 2 tha morning, nor break any bone of it: according 2 all tha ordinances of tha passover dey shall keep it.

But tha man dat is clean, N is not in a journey, N forbeareth 2 keep tha passover, even tha same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not tha offering of tha LORD in his appointed season, dat man shall bear his sin.

N if a stranger shall stay among u, N will keep tha passover 2 tha LORD; according 2 tha ordinance of tha passover, N according 2 tha manner of it, so shall he do: y’all shall have one ordinance, both 4 tha stranger, N 4 him dat was born in tha land.

N on tha day dat tha tabernacle was reared up tha cloud covered tha tabernacle, namely, tha tent of tha testimony: N at even there was upon tha tabernacle as it were tha appearance of fire, until tha morning.
So it was alway: tha cloud covered it by day, N tha appearance of fire by night.
N when tha cloud was taken up from tha tabernacle, then after dat tha children of Israel journeyed: N in tha place where tha cloud stayed, there tha children of Israel pitched their tents.
At tha commandment of tha LORD tha children of Israel journeyed, N at tha commandment of tha LORD dey pitched: as long as tha cloud stayed upon tha tabernacle dey rested in their tents.
N when tha cloud tarried long upon tha tabernacle many days, then tha children of Israel kept tha charge of tha LORD, N journeyed not.
N so it was, when tha cloud was a few days upon tha tabernacle; according 2 tha commandment of tha LORD dey stayed in their tents, N according 2 tha commandment of tha LORD dey journeyed.

N so it was, when tha cloud stayed from even 2 tha morning, N dat tha cloud was taken up in tha morning, then dey journeyed: whether it was by day or by night dat tha cloud was taken up, dey journeyed.

Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, dat tha cloud tarried upon tha tabernacle, remaining thereon, tha children of Israel stayed in their tents, N journeyed not: but when it was taken up, dey journeyed.
At tha commandment of tha LORD dey rested in tha tents, N at tha commandment of tha LORD dey journeyed: dey kept tha charge of tha LORD, at tha commandment of tha LORD by tha hand of Moses.

10.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Make u two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece will u make ’em: dat u may use ’em 4 tha callin of tha assembly, N 4 tha journeying of tha camps.
N when dey shall blow wit ’em, all tha assembly shall assemble themselves 2 u at tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N if dey blow but wit one trumpet, then tha princes, which r heads of tha thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves 2 u.
When y’all blow an alarm, then tha camps dat lie on tha east parts shall go forward.
When y’all blow an alarm tha second time, then tha camps dat lie on tha south side shall take their journey: dey shall blow an alarm 4 their journeys.
But when tha congregation is 2 be gathered together, y’all shall blow, but y’all shall not sound an alarm.
N tha sons of Aaron, tha priests, shall blow wit tha trumpets; N dey shall be 2 u 4 an ordinance 4 ever throughout ur generations.

N if y’all go 2 war in ur land against tha opp dat oppresseth u, then y’all shall blow an alarm wit tha trumpets; N y’all shall be remembered before tha LORD ur God, N y’all shall be saved from ur opps.

Also in tha day of ur gladness, N in ur solemn days, N in tha beginnings of ur months, y’all shall blow wit tha trumpets over ur burnt offerings, N over tha sacrifices of ur peace offerings; dat dey may be 2 u 4 a memorial before ur God: I am tha LORD ur God.
N it happened on tha twentieth day of tha second month, in tha second year, dat tha cloud was taken up from off tha tabernacle of tha testimony.
N tha children of Israel took their journeys out of tha wilderness of Sinai; N tha cloud rested in tha wilderness of Paran.
N dey first took their journey according 2 tha commandment of tha LORD by tha hand of Moses.
In tha first place went tha standard of tha camp of tha children of Judah according 2 their armies: N over his host was Nahshon tha son of Amminadab.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Issachar was Nethaneel tha son of Zuar.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Zebulun was Eliab tha son of Helon.
N tha tabernacle was taken down; N tha sons of Gershon N tha sons of Merari set forward, bearin tha tabernacle.
N tha standard of tha camp of Reuben set forward according 2 their armies: N over his host was Elizur tha son of Shedeur.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Simeon was Shelumiel tha son of Zurishaddai.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Gad was Eliasaph tha son of Deuel.
N tha Kohathites set forward, bearin tha sanctuary: N tha other did set up tha tabernacle against dey came.
N tha standard of tha camp of tha children of Ephraim set forward according 2 their armies: N over his host was Elishama tha son of Ammihud.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Manasseh was Gamaliel tha son of Pedahzur.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Benjamin was Abidan tha son of Gideoni.
N tha standard of tha camp of tha children of Dan set forward, which was tha rereward of all tha camps throughout their hosts: N over his host was Ahiezer tha son of Ammishaddai.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Asher was Pagiel tha son of Ocran.
N over tha host of tha tribe of tha children of Naphtali was Ahira tha son of Enan.
Like dis were tha journeyings of tha children of Israel according 2 their armies, when dey set forward.

N Moses said 2 Hobab, tha son of Raguel tha Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We r journeying 2 tha place of which tha LORD said, I will give it u: come u wit us, N we will do u good: 4 tha LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.
N he said 2 him, I will not go; but I will depart 2 my own land, N 2 my kindred.
N he said, Leave us not, I pray u; forasmuch as u know how we r 2 encamp in tha wilderness, N u may be 2 us instead of eyes.
N it will be, if u go wit us, yeah, it shall be, dat what goodness tha LORD shall do 2 us, tha same will we do 2 u.
N dey departed from tha mount of tha LORD three days’ journey: N tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD went before ’em in tha three days’ journey, 2 search out a resting place 4 ’em.
N tha cloud of tha LORD was upon ’em by day, when dey went out of tha camp.
N it happened, when tha ark set forward, dat Moses said, Rise up, LORD, N let thine opps be scattered; N let ’em dat hate u flee before u.
N when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, 2 tha many thousands of Israel.

11.text: N when tha people complained, it displeased tha LORD: N tha LORD heard it; N his anger was kindled; N tha fire of tha LORD burnt among ’em, N consumed ’em dat were in tha uttermost parts of tha camp.
N tha people cried 2 Moses; N when Moses prayed 2 tha LORD, tha fire was quenched.
N he called tha name of tha place Taberah: because tha fire of tha LORD burnt among ’em.
N tha mixt crowd dat was among ’em fell a lusting: N tha children of Israel also wept again, N said, Who shall give us flesh 2 eat?
We remember tha fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; tha cucumbers, N tha melons, N tha leeks, N tha onions, N tha garlick:
But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside dis manna, before our eyes.
N tha manna was as coriander seed, N tha colour of it as tha colour of bdellium.
N tha people went about, N gathered it, N ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, N baked it in pans, N made cakes of it: N tha taste of it was as tha taste of fresh oil.
N when tha dew fell upon tha camp in tha night, tha manna fell upon it.
Then Moses heard tha people weep throughout their families, every man in tha door of his tent: N tha anger of tha LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
N Moses said 2 tha LORD, so have u afflicted ur servant? N so have I not found favour in ur sight, dat u lay tha burden of all dis people upon me?
Have I conceived all dis people? have I begotten ’em, dat u should say 2 me, Carry ’em in ur bosom, as a nursing father bears tha sucking child, 2 tha land which u swarest 2 their fathers?
From where should I have flesh 2 give 2 all dis people? 4 dey weep 2 me, sayin, Give us flesh, dat we may eat.
I am not able 2 bear all dis people alone, because it is too heavy 4 me.
N if u deal like dis wit me, kill me, I pray u, out of hand, if I have found favour in ur sight; N let me not see my wretchedness.

N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Gather 2 me seventy men of tha elders of Israel, whom u know 2 be tha elders of tha people, N officers over ’em; N bring ’em 2 tha tabernacle of tha congregation, dat dey may stand there wit u.
N I will come down N talk wit u there: N I will take of tha spirit which is upon u, N will put it upon ’em; N dey shall bear tha burden of tha people wit u, dat u bear it not urself alone.

N say u 2 tha people, Sanctify y’all against 2 morrow, N y’all shall eat flesh: 4 y’all have wept in tha ears of tha LORD, sayin, Who shall give us flesh 2 eat? 4 it was well wit us in Egypt: therefore tha LORD will give u flesh, N y’all shall eat.
y’all shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

But even a whole month, until it come out at ur nostrils, N it be loathsome 2 u: because dat y’all have despised tha LORD which is among u, N have wept before him, sayin, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
N Moses said, tha people, among whom I am, r six hundred thousand footmen; N u have said, I will give ’em flesh, dat dey may eat a whole month.
Shall tha flocks N tha herds be killed 4 ’em, 2 suffice ’em? or shall all tha fish of tha sea be gathered together 4 ’em, 2 suffice ’em?
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Is tha LORD’s hand grew short? u will see now whether my word shall come 2 pass 2 u or not.
N Moses went out, N told tha people tha words of tha LORD, N gathered tha seventy men of tha elders of tha people, N set ’em round about tha tabernacle.

N tha LORD came down in a cloud, N spoke 2 him, N took of tha spirit dat was upon him, N gave it 2 tha seventy elders: N it happened, dat, when tha spirit rested upon ’em, dey prophesied, N did not cease.

But there remained two of tha men in tha camp, tha name of tha one was Eldad, N tha name of tha other Medad: N tha spirit rested upon ’em; N dey were of ’em dat were written, but went not out 2 tha tabernacle: N dey prophesied in tha camp.
N there ran a young man, N told Moses, N said, Eldad N Medad do prophesy in tha camp.
N Joshua tha son of Nun, tha servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered, My lord Moses, forbid ’em.
N Moses said 2 him, Enviest u 4 my sake? would God dat all tha LORD’s people were prophets, N dat tha LORD would put his spirit upon ’em!
N Moses got him in2 tha camp, he N tha elders of Israel.

N there went forth a wind from tha LORD, N brought quails from tha sea, N let ’em fall by tha camp, as it were a day’s journey on dis side, N as it were a day’s journey on tha other side, round about tha camp, N as it were two cubits high upon tha face of tha earth.

N tha people stood up all dat day, N all dat night, N all tha next day, N dey gathered tha quails: he dat gathered least gathered ten homers: N dey spread ’em all abroad 4 themselves round about tha camp.
N while tha flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, tha wrath of tha LORD was kindled against tha people, N tha LORD struck tha people wit a very great plague.
N he called tha name of dat place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there dey buried tha people dat lusted.
N tha people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah 2 Hazeroth; N stayed at Hazeroth.

12.text: N Miriam N Aaron spoke against Moses because of tha Ethiopian woman whom he had married: 4 he had married an Ethiopian woman.
N dey said, has tha LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? has he not spoken also by us? N tha LORD heard it.
(Now tha man Moses was very meek, above all tha men which were upon tha face of tha earth.)
N tha LORD spoke suddenly 2 Moses, N 2 Aaron, N 2 Miriam, Come out y’all three 2 tha tabernacle of tha congregation. N dey three came out.
N tha LORD came down in tha pillar of tha cloud, N stood in tha door of tha tabernacle, N called Aaron N Miriam: N dey both came forth.
N he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among u, I tha LORD will make myself known 2 him in a vision, N will speak 2 him in a dream.
My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
Wit him will I speak mouth 2 mouth, even apparently, N not in dark speeches; N tha similitude of tha LORD shall he look: so then were y’all not afraid 2 speak against my servant Moses?
N tha anger of tha LORD was kindled against ’em; N he departed.
N tha cloud departed from off tha tabernacle; N, look, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: N Aaron looked upon Miriam, N, look, she was leprous.
N Aaron said 2 Moses, Alas, my lord, I beg u, lay not tha sin upon us, in which we have done foolishly, N in which we have sinned.
Let her not be as one dead, of whom tha flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.
N Moses cried 2 tha LORD, sayin, Heal her now, O God, I beg u.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from tha camp seven days, N after dat let her be received in again.
N Miriam was shut out from tha camp seven days: N tha people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
N afterward tha people removed from Hazeroth, N pitched in tha wilderness of Paran.

13.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Send u men, dat dey may search tha land of Canaan, which I give 2 tha children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall y’all send a man, every one a ruler among ’em.
N Moses by tha commandment of tha LORD sent ’em from tha wilderness of Paran: all dose men were heads of tha children of Israel.
N dese were their namez: of tha tribe of Reuben, Shammua tha son of Zaccur.
Of tha tribe of Simeon, Shaphat tha son of Hori.
Of tha tribe of Judah, Caleb tha son of Jephunneh.
Of tha tribe of Issachar, Igal tha son of Joseph.
Of tha tribe of Ephraim, Oshea tha son of Nun.
Of tha tribe of Benjamin, Palti tha son of Raphu.
Of tha tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel tha son of Sodi.
Of tha tribe of Joseph, namely, of tha tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi tha son of Susi.
Of tha tribe of Dan, Ammiel tha son of Gemalli.
Of tha tribe of Asher, Sethur tha son of Michael.
Of tha tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi tha son of Vophsi.
Of tha tribe of Gad, Geuel tha son of Machi.
Dese r tha namez of tha men which Moses sent 2 spy out tha land. N Moses called Oshea tha son of Nun Jehoshua.
N Moses sent ’em 2 spy out tha land of Canaan, N said 2 ’em, Get u up dis way southward, N go up in2 tha mountain:
N see tha land, what it is; N tha people dat lives in it, whether dey be strong or weak, few or many;
N what tha land is dat dey live in, whether it be good or bad; N what citiez dey be dat dey live in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
N what tha land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood in it, or not. N be y’all of good courage, N bring of tha fruit of tha land. Now tha time was tha time of tha firstripe grapes.
So dey went up, N searched tha land from tha wilderness of Zin 2 Rehob, as men come 2 Hamath.
N dey ascended by tha south, N came 2 Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, N Talmai, tha children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
N dey came 2 tha brook of Eshcol, N cut down from thence a branch wit one cluster of grapes, N dey bare it between two upon a staff; N dey brought of tha pomegranates, N of tha figs.
Tha place was called tha brook Eshcol, because of tha cluster of grapes which tha children of Israel cut down from thence.
N dey returned from searchin of tha land after forty days.

N dey went N came 2 Moses, N 2 Aaron, N 2 all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, 2 tha wilderness of Paran, 2 Kadesh; N brought back word 2 ’em, N 2 all tha congregation, N showed ’em tha fruit of tha land.
N dey told him, N said, We came 2 tha land where u sentest us, N surely it flows wit milk N honey; N dis is tha fruit of it.
Nevertheless tha people be strong dat live in tha land, N tha citiez r walled, N very great: N moreover we saw tha children of Anak there.
Tha Amalekites live in tha land of tha south: N tha Hittites, N tha Jebusites, N tha Amorites, live in tha mountains: N tha Canaanites live by tha sea, N by tha coast of Jordan.
N Caleb stilled tha people before Moses, N said, Let us go up at once, N possess it; 4 we r well able 2 overcome it.
But tha men dat went up wit him said, We don’t be able 2 go up against tha people; 4 dey r stronger than we.

N dey brought up an evil report of tha land which dey had searched 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, tha land, through which we have gone 2 search it, is a land dat eats up tha inhabitants of it; N all tha people dat we saw in it r men of a great stature.
N there we saw tha giants, tha sons of Anak, which come of tha giants: N we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, N so we were in their sight.

14.text: N all tha congregation lifted up their voice, N cried; N tha people wept dat night.
N all tha children of Israel grumbled against Moses N against Aaron: N tha whole congregation said 2 ’em, Would God dat we had died in tha land of Egypt! or would God we had died in dis wilderness!
N so has tha LORD brought us 2 dis land, 2 fall by tha sword, dat our wives N our children should be a prey? were it not better 4 us 2 return in2 Egypt?
N dey said one 2 another, Let us make a captain, N let us return in2 Egypt.
Then Moses N Aaron fell on their faces before all tha assembly of tha congregation of tha children of Israel.
N Joshua tha son of Nun, N Caleb tha son of Jephunneh, which were of ’em dat searched tha land, rent their clothes:
N dey spoke 2 all tha company of tha children of Israel, sayin, tha land, which we passed through 2 search it, is an exceeding good land.
If tha LORD delight in us, then he will bring us in2 dis land, N give it us; a land which flows wit milk N honey.
Only rebel not y’all against tha LORD, neither fear y’all tha people of tha land; 4 dey r bread 4 us: their defence is departed from ’em, N tha LORD is wit us: fear ’em not.
But all tha congregation told stone ’em wit stones. N tha glory of tha LORD appeared in tha tabernacle of tha congregation before all tha children of Israel.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, How long will dis people provoke me? N how long will it be ere dey believe me, 4 all tha signs which I have showed among ’em?
I will strike ’em wit tha pestilence, N disinherit ’em, N will make of u a greater nation N mightier than dey.
N Moses said 2 tha LORD, Then tha Egyptians shall hear it, (4 u brought up dis people in ur might from among ’em;)

N dey will tell it 2 tha inhabitants of dis land: 4 dey have heard dat u LORD art among dis people, dat u LORD art seen face 2 face, N dat ur cloud stands over ’em, N dat u go before ’em, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, N in a pillar of fire by night.
Now if u will kill all dis people as one man, then tha nations which have heard tha fame of u will speak, sayin,
Because tha LORD was not able 2 bring dis people in2 tha land which he sware 2 ’em, therefore he has killed ’em in tha wilderness.
N now, I beg u, let tha power of my Lord be great, according as u have spoken, sayin,

Tha LORD is longsuffering, N of great mercy, forgiving iniquity N transgression, N by no means clearing tha guilty, visiting tha iniquity of tha fathers upon tha children 2 tha third N fourth generation.
Pardon, I beg u, tha iniquity of dis people according 2 tha greatness of ur mercy, N as u have forgiven dis people, from Egypt even until now.
N tha LORD said, I have pardoned according 2 ur word:
But as truly as I live, all tha earth shall be filled wit tha glory of tha LORD.
Because all dose men which have seen my glory, N my miracles, which I did in Egypt N in tha wilderness, N have tempted me now dese ten times, N have not listened 2 my voice;
Surely dey shall not see tha land which I sware 2 their fathers, neither shall any of ’em dat provoked me see it:
But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit wit him, N has followed me fully, him will I bring in2 tha land whereinto he went; N his seed shall possess it.
(Now tha Amalekites N tha Canaanites lived in tha valley.) 2 morrow turn u, N get u in2 tha wilderness by tha way of tha Red sea.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
How long shall I bear wit dis evil congregation, which grumble against me? I have heard tha grumblin of tha children of Israel, which dey grumble against me.
Say 2 ’em, As truly as I live, says tha LORD, as y’all have spoken in mine ears, so will I do 2 u:
Ur carcases shall fall in dis wilderness; N all dat were numbered of u, according 2 ur whole number, from twenty years old N upward, which have grumbled against me,
Doubtless y’all shall not come in2 tha land, concerning which I sware 2 make u live in it, save Caleb tha son of Jephunneh, N Joshua tha son of Nun.
But ur little ones, which y’all said should be a prey, ’em will I bring in, N dey shall know tha land which y’all have despised.
But as 4 u, ur carcases, dey shall fall in dis wilderness.
N ur children shall wander in tha wilderness forty years, N bear ur whoredoms, until ur carcases be wasted in tha wilderness.
After tha number of tha days in which y’all searched tha land, even forty days, each day 4 a year, shall y’all bear ur iniquities, even forty years, N y’all shall know my breach of promise.
I tha LORD have said, I will surely do it 2 all dis evil congregation, dat r gathered together against me: in dis wilderness dey shall be consumed, N there dey shall die.
N tha men, which Moses sent 2 search tha land, who returned, N made all tha congregation 2 grumble against him, by bringin up a slander upon tha land,
Even dose men dat did bring up tha evil report upon tha land, died by tha plague before tha LORD.
But Joshua tha son of Nun, N Caleb tha son of Jephunneh, which were of tha men dat went 2 search tha land, lived still.
N Moses told dese sayings 2 all tha children of Israel: N tha people mourned greatly.
N dey rose up early in tha morning, N got ’em up in2 tha top of tha mountain, sayin, look, we be here, N will go up 2 tha place which tha LORD has promised: 4 we have sinned.
N Moses said, so now do y’all transgress tha commandment of tha LORD? but it shall not prosper.
Go not up, 4 tha LORD is not among u; dat y’all don’t be struck before ur opps.
4 tha Amalekites N tha Canaanites r there before u, N y’all shall fall by tha sword: because y’all r turned away from tha LORD, therefore tha LORD will not be wit u.
But dey presumed 2 go up 2 tha hill top: nevertheless tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD, N Moses, departed not out of tha camp.
Then tha Amalekites came down, N tha Canaanites which lived in dat hill, N struck ’em, N discomfited ’em, even 2 Hormah.

15.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When y’all be come in2 tha land of ur habitations, which I give 2 u,

N will make an offering by fire 2 tha LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in ur solemn feasts, 2 make a sweet savour 2 tha LORD, of tha herd, or of tha flock:
Then shall he dat offers his offering 2 tha LORD bring a food offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled wit tha fourth part of an hin of oil.
N tha fourth part of an hin of wine 4 a drink offering will u prepare wit tha burnt offering or sacrifice, 4 one lamb.
Or 4 a ram, u will prepare 4 a food offering two tenth deals of flour mingled wit tha third part of an hin of oil.
N 4 a drink offering u will offer tha third part of an hin of wine, 4 a sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
N when u preparest a bullock 4 a burnt offering, or 4 a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings 2 tha LORD:
Then shall he bring wit a bullock a food offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled wit half an hin of oil.
N u will bring 4 a drink offering half an hin of wine, 4 an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
Like dis shall it be done 4 one bullock, or 4 one ram, or 4 a lamb, or a kid.
According 2 tha number dat y’all shall prepare, so shall y’all do 2 every one according 2 their number.
All dat r born of tha country shall do dese things after dis manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
N if a stranger stay wit u, or whoever be among u in ur generations, N will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour 2 tha LORD; as y’all do, so he shall do.
One ordinance shall be both 4 u of tha congregation, N also 4 tha stranger dat stays wit u, an ordinance 4 ever in ur generations: as y’all r, so shall tha stranger be before tha LORD.
One law N one manner shall be 4 u, N 4 tha stranger dat stays wit u.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When y’all come in2 tha land where I bring u,
Then it shall be, dat, when y’all eat of tha bread of tha land, y’all shall offer up an heave offering 2 tha LORD.
y’all shall offer up a cake of tha first of ur dough 4 an heave offering: as y’all do tha heave offering of tha threshingfloor, so shall y’all heave it.
Of tha first of ur dough y’all shall give 2 tha LORD an heave offering in ur generations.
N if y’all have erred, N not observed all dese commandments, which tha LORD has spoken 2 Moses,
Even all dat tha LORD has commanded u by tha hand of Moses, from tha day dat tha LORD commanded Moses, N henceforward among ur generations;

Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without tha knowledge of tha congregation, dat all tha congregation shall offer one young bullock 4 a burnt offering, 4 a sweet savour 2 tha LORD, wit his food offering, N his drink offering, according 2 tha manner, N one kid of tha goats 4 a sin offering.

N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, N it will be forgiven ’em; 4 it is ignorance: N dey shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire 2 tha LORD, N their sin offering before tha LORD, 4 their ignorance:
N it will be forgiven all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, N tha stranger dat stays among ’em; seein all tha people were in ignorance.
N if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of tha first year 4 a sin offering.
N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 tha soul dat sins ignorantly, when he sins by ignorance before tha LORD, 2 make an atonement 4 him; N it will be forgiven him.
y’all shall have one law 4 him dat sins through ignorance, both 4 him dat is born among tha children of Israel, N 4 tha stranger dat stays among ’em.
But tha soul dat does ought presumptuously, whether he be born in tha land, or a stranger, tha same reproaches tha LORD; N dat soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Because he has despised tha word of tha LORD, N has broken his commandment, dat soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
N while tha children of Israel were in tha wilderness, dey found a man dat gathered sticks upon tha sabbath day.
N dey dat found him gatherin sticks brought him 2 Moses N Aaron, N 2 all tha congregation.
N dey put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done 2 him.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, tha man shall be surely put 2 death: all tha congregation shall stone him wit stones without tha camp.
N all tha congregation brought him without tha camp, N stoned him wit stones, N he died; as tha LORD commanded Moses.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N bid ’em dat dey make ’em fringes in tha borders of their garments throughout their generations, N dat dey put upon tha fringe of tha borders a ribband of blue:

N it will be 2 u 4 a fringe, dat y’all may look upon it, N remember all tha commandments of tha LORD, N do ’em; N dat y’all seek not after ur own heart N ur own eyes, after which y’all use 2 go a whoring:
Dat y’all may remember, N do all my commandments, N be holy 2 ur God.
I am tha LORD ur God, which brought u out of tha land of Egypt, 2 be ur God: I am tha LORD ur God.

16.text: Now Korah, tha son of Izhar, tha son of Kohath, tha son of Levi, N Dathan N Abiram, tha sons of Eliab, N On, tha son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
N dey rose up before Moses, wit certain of tha children of Israel, two hundred N fifty princes of tha assembly, famous in tha congregation, men of renown:

N dey gathered themselves together against Moses N against Aaron, N said 2 ’em, y’all take too much upon u, seein all tha congregation r holy, every one of ’em, N tha LORD is among ’em: so then lift y’all up y’all above tha congregation of tha LORD?
N when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

N he spoke 2 Korah N 2 all his company, sayin, Even 2 morrow tha LORD will show who r his, N who is holy; N will cause him 2 come near 2 him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause 2 come near 2 him.
Dis do; Take u censers, Korah, N all his company;
N put fire in it, N put incense in ’em before tha LORD 2 morrow: N it will be dat tha man whom tha LORD does choose, he shall be holy: y’all take too much upon u, y’all sons of Levi.
N Moses said 2 Korah, Hear, I pray u, y’all sons of Levi:

Seems it but a small thing 2 u, dat tha God of Israel has separated u from tha congregation of Israel, 2 bring u near 2 himself 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle of tha LORD, N 2 stand before tha congregation 2 minister 2 ’em?
N he has brought u near 2 him, N all ur brothers tha sons of Levi wit u: N seek y’all tha priesthood also?
4 which cause both u N all ur company r gathered together against tha LORD: N what is Aaron, dat y’all grumble against him?
N Moses sent 2 call Dathan N Abiram, tha sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
Is it a small thing dat u have brought us up out of a land dat flows wit milk N honey, 2 kill us in tha wilderness, except u make urself altogether a prince over us?
Moreover u have not brought us in2 a land dat flows wit milk N honey, or given us inheritance of fields N vineyards: will u put out tha eyes of dese men? we will not come up.
N Moses was very angry, N said 2 tha LORD, Respect not u their offering: I have not taken one ass from ’em, neither have I hurt one of ’em.
N Moses said 2 Korah, Be u N all ur company before tha LORD, u, N dey, N Aaron, 2 morrow:
N take every man his censer, N put incense in ’em, N bring y’all before tha LORD every man his censer, two hundred N fifty censers; u also, N Aaron, each of u his censer.
N dey took every man his censer, N put fire in ’em, N laid incense thereon, N stood in tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation wit Moses N Aaron.
N Korah gathered all tha congregation against ’em 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation: N tha glory of tha LORD appeared 2 all tha congregation.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
Separate y’all from among dis congregation, dat I may consume ’em in a moment.
N dey fell upon their faces, N said, O God, tha God of tha spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, N will u be angry wit all tha congregation?
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha congregation, sayin, Get u up from about tha tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, N Abiram.
N Moses rose up N went 2 Dathan N Abiram; N tha elders of Israel followed him.
N he spoke 2 tha congregation, sayin, Depart, I pray u, from tha tents of dese wicked men, N touch nothing of theirs, lest y’all be consumed in all their sins.
So dey got up from tha tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, N Abiram, on every side: N Dathan N Abiram came out, N stood in tha door of their tents, N their wives, N their sons, N their little children.
N Moses said, by dis y’all shall know dat tha LORD has sent me 2 do all dese works; 4 I have not done ’em of my own mind.
If dese men die tha common death of all men, or if dey be visited after tha visitation of all men; then tha LORD has not sent me.

But if tha LORD make a new thing, N tha earth open her mouth, N swallow ’em up, wit all dat appertain 2 ’em, N dey go down quick in2 tha pit; then y’all shall understand dat dese men have provoked tha LORD.
N it happened, as he had made an end of speakin all dese words, dat tha ground clave asunder dat was under ’em:
N tha earth opened her mouth, N swallowed ’em up, N their houses, N all tha men dat appertained 2 Korah, N all their goods.
Dey, N all dat appertained 2 ’em, went down alive in2 tha pit, N tha earth closed upon ’em: N dey perished from among tha congregation.
N all Israel dat were round about ’em fled at tha cry of ’em: 4 dey said, Lest tha earth swallow us up also.
N there came out a fire from tha LORD, N consumed tha two hundred N fifty men dat offered incense.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Eleazar tha son of Aaron tha priest, dat he take up tha censers out of tha burnin, N scatter u tha fire yonder; 4 dey r hallowed.

Tha censers of dese sinners against their own souls, let ’em make ’em broad plates 4 a covering of tha altar: 4 dey offered ’em before tha LORD, therefore dey r hallowed: N dey shall be a sign 2 tha children of Israel.
N Eleazar tha priest took tha brasen censers, wherewith dey dat were burnt had offered; N dey were made broad plates 4 a covering of tha altar:

2 be a memorial 2 tha children of Israel, dat no stranger, which is not of tha seed of Aaron, come near 2 offer incense before tha LORD; dat he don’t be as Korah, N as his company: as tha LORD said 2 him by tha hand of Moses.
But on tha morrow all tha congregation of tha children of Israel grumbled against Moses N against Aaron, sayin, y’all have killed tha people of tha LORD.

N it happened, when tha congregation was gathered against Moses N against Aaron, dat dey looked toward tha tabernacle of tha congregation: N, look, tha cloud covered it, N tha glory of tha LORD appeared.
N Moses N Aaron came before tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Get u up from among dis congregation, dat I may consume ’em as in a moment. N dey fell upon their faces.

N Moses said 2 Aaron, Take a censer, N put fire in it from off tha altar, N put on incense, N go quickly 2 tha congregation, N make an atonement 4 ’em: 4 there is wrath gone out from tha LORD; tha plague is begun.
N Aaron took as Moses commanded, N ran in2 tha midst of tha congregation; N, look, tha plague was begun among tha people: N he put on incense, N made an atonement 4 tha people.
N he stood between tha dead N tha livin; N tha plague was stayed.
Now dey dat died in tha plague were fourteen thousand N seven hundred, beside ’em dat died about tha matter of Korah.
N Aaron returned 2 Moses 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation: N tha plague was stayed.

17.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N take of every one of ’em a rod according 2 tha house of their fathers, of all their princes according 2 tha house of their fathers twelve rods: write u every man’s name upon his rod.
N u will write Aaron’s name upon tha rod of Levi: 4 one rod shall be 4 tha head of tha house of their fathers.
N u will lay ’em up in tha tabernacle of tha congregation before tha testimony, where I will meet wit u.
N it will happen, dat tha man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: N I will make 2 cease from me tha grumblin of tha children of Israel, whereby dey grumble against u.

N Moses spoke 2 tha children of Israel, N every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, 4 each prince one, according 2 their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: N tha rod of Aaron was among their rods.
N Moses laid up tha rods before tha LORD in tha tabernacle of witness.
N it happened, dat on tha morrow Moses went in2 tha tabernacle of witness; N, look, tha rod of Aaron 4 tha house of Levi was budded, N brought forth buds, N bloomed blossoms, N yielded almonds.
N Moses brought out all tha rods from before tha LORD 2 all tha children of Israel: N dey looked, N took every man his rod.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before tha testimony, 2 be kept 4 a token against tha rebels; N u will quite take away their grumblin from me, dat dey die not.
N Moses did so: as tha LORD commanded him, so did he.
N tha children of Israel spoke 2 Moses, sayin, look, we die, we perish, we all perish.
Whoever comes any thing near 2 tha tabernacle of tha LORD shall die: shall we be consumed wit dyin?

18.text: N tha LORD said 2 Aaron, u N ur sons N ur father’s house wit u shall bear tha iniquity of tha sanctuary: N u N ur sons wit u shall bear tha iniquity of ur priesthood.
N ur brothers also of tha tribe of Levi, tha tribe of ur father, bring u wit u, dat dey may be joined 2 u, N minister 2 u: but u N ur sons wit u shall minister before tha tabernacle of witness.
N dey shall keep ur charge, N tha charge of all tha tabernacle: only dey shall not come nigh tha vessels of tha sanctuary N tha altar, dat neither dey, nor y’all also, die.
N dey shall be joined 2 u, N keep tha charge of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 4 all tha service of tha tabernacle: N a stranger shall not come nigh 2 u.
N y’all shall keep tha charge of tha sanctuary, N tha charge of tha altar: dat there be no wrath any more upon tha children of Israel.
N I, look, I have taken ur brothers tha Levites from among tha children of Israel: 2 u dey r given as a gift 4 tha LORD, 2 do tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.

Therefore u N ur sons wit u shall keep ur priest’s office 4 every thing of tha altar, N within tha vail; N y’all shall serve: I have given ur priest’s office 2 u as a service of gift: N tha stranger dat comes nigh shall be put 2 death.

N tha LORD spoke 2 Aaron, look, I also have given u tha charge of mine heave offerings of all tha hallowed things of tha children of Israel; 2 u have I given ’em by reason of tha anointing, N 2 ur sons, by an ordinance 4 ever.

Dis shall be thine of tha most holy things, reserved from tha fire: every oblation of theirs, every food offering of theirs, N every sin offering of theirs, N every trespass offering of theirs, which dey shall render 2 me, shall be most holy 4 u N 4 ur sons.
In tha most holy place will u eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy 2 u.

N dis is thine; tha heave offering of their gift, wit all tha wave offerings of tha children of Israel: I have given ’em 2 u, N 2 ur sons N 2 ur daughters wit u, by a statute 4 ever: every one dat is clean in ur house shall eat of it.
All tha best of tha oil, N all tha best of tha wine, N of tha wheat, tha firstfruits of ’em which dey shall offer 2 tha LORD, ’em have I given u.
N whatever is first ripe in tha land, which dey shall bring 2 tha LORD, shall be thine; every one dat is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

Every thing dat opens tha matrix in all flesh, which dey bring 2 tha LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless tha firstborn of man will u surely redeem, N tha firstling of unclean beasts will u redeem.
N dose dat r 2 be redeemed from a month old will u redeem, according 2 thine estimation, 4 tha money of five shekels, after tha shekel of tha sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

But tha firstling of a cow, or tha firstling of a sheep, or tha firstling of a goat, u will not redeem; dey r holy: u will sprinkle their blood upon tha altar, N will burn their fat 4 an offering made by fire, 4 a sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
N tha flesh of ’em shall be thine, as tha wave breast N as tha right shoulder r thine.

All tha heave offerings of tha holy things, which tha children of Israel offer 2 tha LORD, have I given u, N ur sons N ur daughters wit u, by a statute 4 ever: it is a covenant of salt 4 ever before tha LORD 2 u N 2 ur seed wit u.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Aaron, u will have no inheritance in their land, neither will u have any part among ’em: I am ur part N thine inheritance among tha children of Israel.
N, look, I have given tha children of Levi all tha tenth in Israel 4 an inheritance, 4 their service which dey serve, even tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
Neither must tha children of Israel from now on come nigh tha tabernacle of tha congregation, lest dey bear sin, N die.

But tha Levites shall do tha service of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N dey shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute 4 ever throughout ur generations, dat among tha children of Israel dey have no inheritance.

But tha tithes of tha children of Israel, which dey offer as an heave offering 2 tha LORD, I have given 2 tha Levites 2 inherit: therefore I have said 2 ’em, Among tha children of Israel dey shall have no inheritance.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Like dis speak 2 tha Levites, N say 2 ’em, When y’all take of tha children of Israel tha tithes which I have given u from ’em 4 ur inheritance, then y’all shall offer up an heave offering of it 4 tha LORD, even a tenth part of tha tithe.
N dis ur heave offering shall be reckoned 2 u, as though it were tha corn of tha threshingfloor, N as tha fulness of tha winepress.
Like dis y’all also shall offer an heave offering 2 tha LORD of all ur tithes, which y’all receive of tha children of Israel; N y’all shall give of it tha LORD’s heave offering 2 Aaron tha priest.
Out of all ur gifts y’all shall offer every heave offering of tha LORD, of all tha best of it, even tha hallowed part of it out of it.
Therefore u will say 2 ’em, When y’all have heaved tha best of it from it, then it shall be counted 2 tha Levites as tha increase of tha threshingfloor, N as tha increase of tha winepress.
N y’all shall eat it in every place, y’all N ur households: 4 it is ur reward 4 ur service in tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N y’all shall bear no sin by reason of it, when y’all have heaved from it tha best of it: neither shall y’all pollute tha holy things of tha children of Israel, lest y’all die.

19.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
Dis is tha ordinance of tha law which tha LORD has commanded, sayin, Speak 2 tha children of Israel, dat dey bring u a red heifer without spot, in which is no blemish, N upon which never came yoke:
N y’all shall give her 2 Eleazar tha priest, dat he may bring her forth without tha camp, N one shall kill her before his face:
N Eleazar tha priest shall take of her blood wit his finger, N sprinkle of her blood directly before tha tabernacle of tha congregation seven times:
N one shall burn tha heifer in his sight; her skin, N her flesh, N her blood, wit her dung, shall he burn:
N tha priest shall take cedar wood, N hyssop, N scarlet, N cast it in2 tha midst of tha burnin of tha heifer.
Then tha priest shall wash his clothes, N he shall bathe his flesh in water, N afterward he shall come in2 tha camp, N tha priest shall be unclean until tha even.
N he dat burns her shall wash his clothes in water, N bathe his flesh in water, N shall be unclean until tha even.

N a man dat is clean shall gather up tha ashes of tha heifer, N lay ’em up without tha camp in a clean place, N it will be kept 4 tha congregation of tha children of Israel 4 a water of separation: it is a purification 4 sin.
N he dat gathers tha ashes of tha heifer shall wash his clothes, N be unclean until tha even: N it will be 2 tha children of Israel, N 2 tha stranger dat stays among ’em, 4 a statute 4 ever.
He dat touches tha dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
He shall purify himself wit it on tha third day, N on tha seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself tha third day, then tha seventh day he shall not be clean.

Whoever touches tha dead body of any man dat is dead, N purifieth not himself, defiles tha tabernacle of tha LORD; N dat soul shall be cut off from Israel: because tha water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
Dis is tha law, when a man dies in a tent: all dat come in2 tha tent, N all dat is in tha tent, shall be unclean seven days.
N every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
N whoever touches one dat is killed wit a sword in tha open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
N 4 an unclean person dey shall take of tha ashes of tha burnt heifer of purification 4 sin, N runnin water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

N a clean person shall take hyssop, N dip it in tha water, N sprinkle it upon tha tent, N upon all tha vessels, N upon tha persons dat were there, N upon him dat touched a bone, or one killed, or one dead, or a grave:

N tha clean person shall sprinkle upon tha unclean on tha third day, N on tha seventh day: N on tha seventh day he shall purify himself, N wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N shall be clean at even.

But tha man dat shall be unclean, N shall not purify himself, dat soul shall be cut off from among tha congregation, because he has defiled tha sanctuary of tha LORD: tha water of separation has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
N it will be a perpetual statute 2 ’em, dat he dat sprinkleth tha water of separation shall wash his clothes; N he dat touches tha water of separation shall be unclean until even.
N whatever tha unclean person touches shall be unclean; N tha soul dat touches it shall be unclean until even.

20.text: Then came tha children of Israel, even tha whole congregation, in2 tha desert of Zin in tha first month: N tha people stayed in Kadesh; N Miriam died there, N was buried there.
N there was no water 4 tha congregation: N dey gathered themselves together against Moses N against Aaron.
N tha people chode wit Moses, N spoke, sayin, Would God dat we had died when our brothers died before tha LORD!
N why have y’all brought up tha congregation of tha LORD in2 dis wilderness, dat we N our cattle should die there?
N so have y’all made us 2 come up out of Egypt, 2 bring us in 2 dis evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water 2 drink.
N Moses N Aaron went from tha presence of tha assembly 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N dey fell upon their faces: N tha glory of tha LORD appeared 2 ’em.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Take tha rod, N gather u tha assembly together, u, N Aaron ur brother, N speak y’all 2 tha rock before their eyes; N it shall give forth his water, N u will bring forth 2 ’em water out of tha rock: so u will give tha congregation N their beasts drink.
N Moses took tha rod from before tha LORD, as he commanded him.
N Moses N Aaron gathered tha congregation together before tha rock, N he said 2 ’em, Hear now, y’all rebels; must we fetch u water out of dis rock?
N Moses lifted up his hand, N wit his rod he struck tha rock twice: N tha water came out abundantly, N tha congregation drank, N their beasts also.

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N Aaron, Because y’all believed me not, 2 sanctify me in tha eyes of tha children of Israel, therefore y’all shall not bring dis congregation in2 tha land which I have given ’em.
Dis is tha water of Meribah; because tha children of Israel strove wit tha LORD, N he was sanctified in ’em.
N Moses sent messengers from Kadesh 2 tha king of Edom, like dis says ur brother Israel, u know all tha travail dat has befallen us:
How our fathers went down in2 Egypt, N we have lived in Egypt a long time; N tha Egyptians vexed us, N our fathers:
N when we cried 2 tha LORD, he heard our voice, N sent an angel, N has brought us forth out of Egypt: N, look, we r in Kadesh, a city in tha uttermost of ur border:

Let us pass, I pray u, through ur country: we will not pass through tha fields, or through tha vineyards, neither will we drink of tha water of tha wells: we will go by tha king’s high way, we will not turn 2 tha right hand nor 2 tha left, until we have passed ur borders.
N Edom said 2 him, u will not pass by me, lest I come out against u wit tha sword.
N tha children of Israel said 2 him, We will go by tha high way: N if I N my cattle drink of ur water, then I will pay 4 it: I will only, without doin any thing else, go through on my feet.
N he said, u will not go through. N Edom came out against him wit much people, N wit a strong hand.
Like dis Edom refused 2 give Israel passage through his border: so Israel turned away from him.
N tha children of Israel, even tha whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, N came 2 mount Hor.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N Aaron in mount Hor, by tha coast of tha land of Edom, sayin,
Aaron shall be gathered 2 his people: 4 he shall not enter in2 tha land which I have given 2 tha children of Israel, because y’all rebelled against my word at tha water of Meribah.
Take Aaron N Eleazar his son, N bring ’em up 2 mount Hor:
N strip Aaron of his garments, N put ’em upon Eleazar his son: N Aaron shall be gathered 2 his people, N shall die there.
N Moses did as tha LORD commanded: N dey went up in2 mount Hor in tha sight of all tha congregation.
N Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, N put ’em upon Eleazar his son; N Aaron died there in tha top of tha mount: N Moses N Eleazar came down from tha mount.
N when all tha congregation saw dat Aaron was dead, dey mourned 4 Aaron thirty days, even all tha house of Israel.

21.text: N when king Arad tha Canaanite, which lived in tha south, heard tell dat Israel came by tha way of tha spies; then he fought against Israel, N took some of ’em prisoners.
N Israel vowed a vow 2 tha LORD, N said, If u will indeed deliver dis people in2 my hand, then I will utterly destroy their citiez.
N tha LORD listened 2 tha voice of Israel, N delivered up tha Canaanites; N dey utterly destroyed ’em N their citiez: N he called tha name of tha place Hormah.
N dey journeyed from mount Hor by tha way of tha Red sea, 2 compass tha land of Edom: N tha soul of tha people was much discouraged because of tha way.

N tha people spoke against God, N against Moses, so have y’all brought us up out of Egypt 2 die in tha wilderness? 4 there is no bread, neither is there any water; N our soul loatheth dis light bread.
N tha LORD sent fiery serpents among tha people, N dey bit tha people; N much people of Israel died.
Therefore tha people came 2 Moses, N said, We have sinned, 4 we have spoken against tha LORD, N against u; pray 2 tha LORD, dat he take away tha serpents from us. N Moses prayed 4 tha people.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Make u a fiery serpent, N set it upon a pole: N it will happen, dat every one dat is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live.
N Moses made a serpent of brass, N put it upon a pole, N it happened, dat if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld tha serpent of brass, he lived.
N tha children of Israel set forward, N pitched in Oboth.
N dey journeyed from Oboth, N pitched at Ije-abarim, in tha wilderness which is before Moab, toward tha sunrising.
From thence dey removed, N pitched in tha valley of Zared.
From thence dey removed, N pitched on tha other side of Arnon, which is in tha wilderness dat comes out of tha coasts of tha Amorites: 4 Arnon is tha border of Moab, between Moab N tha Amorites.
So it is said in tha book of tha wars of tha LORD, What he did in tha Red sea, N in tha brooks of Arnon,
N at tha stream of tha brooks dat goes down 2 tha livin of Ar, N lies upon tha border of Moab.
N from thence dey went 2 Beer: dat is tha well whereof tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, Gather tha people together, N I will give ’em water.
Then Israel sang dis song, Spring up, O well; sing y’all 2 it:
Tha princes digged tha well, tha nobles of tha people digged it, by tha direction of tha lawgiver, wit their staves. N from tha wilderness dey went 2 Mattanah:
N from Mattanah 2 Nahaliel: N from Nahaliel 2 Bamoth:
N from Bamoth in tha valley, dat is in tha country of Moab, 2 tha top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.
N Israel sent messengers 2 Sihon king of tha Amorites, sayin,

Let me pass through ur land: we will not turn in2 tha fields, or in2 tha vineyards; we will not drink of tha waterz of tha well: but we will go along by tha king’s high way, until we be past ur borders.
N Sihon would not suffer Israel 2 pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, N went out against Israel in2 tha wilderness: N he came 2 Jahaz, N fought against Israel.
N Israel struck him wit tha edge of tha sword, N possessed his land from Arnon 2 Jabbok, even 2 tha children of Ammon: 4 tha border of tha children of Ammon was strong.
N Israel took all dese citiez: N Israel lived in all tha citiez of tha Amorites, in Heshbon, N in all tha villages of it.
4 Heshbon was tha city of Sihon tha king of tha Amorites, who had fought against tha former king of Moab, N taken all his land out of his hand, even 2 Arnon.
So dey dat speak in proverbs say, Come in2 Heshbon, let tha city of Sihon be built N prepared:
4 there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from tha city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, N tha lords of tha high places of Arnon.
Woe 2 u, Moab! u r undone, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons dat escaped, N his daughters, in2 captivity 2 Sihon king of tha Amorites.
We have shot at ’em; Heshbon is perished even 2 Dibon, N we have laid ’em waste even 2 Nophah, which reaches 2 Medeba.
Like dis Israel lived in tha land of tha Amorites.
N Moses sent 2 spy out Jaazer, N dey took tha villages of it, N drove out tha Amorites dat were there.
N dey turned N went up by tha way of Bashan: N Og tha king of Bashan went out against ’em, he, N all his people, 2 tha battle at Edrei.
N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Fear him not: 4 I have delivered him in2 ur hand, N all his people, N his land; N u will do 2 him as u did 2 Sihon king of tha Amorites, which lived at Heshbon.
So dey struck him, N his sons, N all his people, until there was none left him alive: N dey possessed his land.

22.text: N tha children of Israel set forward, N pitched in tha plains of Moab on dis side Jordan by Jericho.
N Balak tha son of Zippor saw all dat Israel had done 2 tha Amorites.
N Moab was sore afraid of tha people, because dey were many: N Moab was distressed because of tha children of Israel.

N Moab said 2 tha elders of Midian, Now shall dis company lick up all dat r round about us, as tha ox licketh up tha grass of tha field. N Balak tha son of Zippor was king of tha Moabites at dat time.

He sent messengers therefore 2 Balaam tha son of Beor 2 Pethor, which is by tha river of tha land of tha children of his people, 2 call him, sayin, look, there is a people come out from Egypt: look, dey cover tha face of tha earth, N dey abide over against me:

Come now therefore, I pray u, curse me dis people; 4 dey r too mighty 4 me: maybe I shall prevail, dat we may strike ’em, N dat I may drive ’em out of tha land: 4 I know dat he whom u bless is blessed, N he whom u curse is cursed.
N tha elders of Moab N tha elders of Midian departed wit tha rewards of divination in their hand; N dey came 2 Balaam, N spoke 2 him tha words of Balak.
N he said 2 ’em, Lodge here dis night, N I will bring u word again, as tha LORD shall speak 2 me: N tha princes of Moab stayed wit Balaam.
N God came 2 Balaam, N said, What men r dese wit u?
N Balaam said 2 God, Balak tha son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent 2 me, sayin,
Look, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covers tha face of tha earth: come now, curse me ’em; maybe I shall be able 2 overcome ’em, N drive ’em out.
N God said 2 Balaam, u will not go wit ’em; u will not curse tha people: 4 dey r blessed.
N Balaam rose up in tha morning, N said 2 tha princes of Balak, Get u in2 ur land: 4 tha LORD refuses 2 give me leave 2 go wit u.
N tha princes of Moab rose up, N dey went 2 Balak, N said, Balaam refuses 2 come wit us.
N Balak sent yet again princes, more, N more honourable than dey.
N dey came 2 Balaam, N said 2 him, like dis says Balak tha son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray u, hinder u from comin 2 me:
4 I will promote u 2 very great honour, N I will do whatever u sayest 2 me: come therefore, I pray u, curse me dis people.
N Balaam answered 2 tha servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver N gold, I cannot go beyond tha word of tha LORD my God, 2 do less or more.
Now therefore, I pray u, tarry y’all also here dis night, dat I may know what tha LORD will say 2 me more.
N God came 2 Balaam at night, N said 2 him, If tha men come 2 call u, rise up, N go wit ’em; but yet tha word which I shall say 2 u, dat will u do.
N Balaam rose up in tha morning, N saddled his ass, N went wit tha princes of Moab.
N God’s anger was kindled because he went: N tha angel of tha LORD stood in tha way 4 an adversary against him. Now he was ridin upon his ass, N his two servants were wit him.
N tha ass saw tha angel of tha LORD standin in tha way, N his sword drawn in his hand: N tha ass turned aside out of tha way, N went in2 tha field: N Balaam struck tha ass, 2 turn her in2 tha way.
But tha angel of tha LORD stood in a path of tha vineyards, a wall bein on dis side, N a wall on dat side.
N when tha ass saw tha angel of tha LORD, she thrust herself 2 tha wall, N crushed Balaam’s foot against tha wall: N he struck her again.
N tha angel of tha LORD went further, N stood in a narrow place, where was no way 2 turn either 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left.
N when tha ass saw tha angel of tha LORD, she fell down under Balaam: N Balaam’s anger was kindled, N he struck tha ass wit a staff.
N tha LORD opened tha mouth of tha ass, N she said 2 Balaam, What have I done 2 u, dat u have struck me dese three times?
N Balaam said 2 tha ass, Because u have mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, 4 now would I kill u.
N tha ass said 2 Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which u have ridden ever since I was thine 2 dis day? was I ever wont 2 do so 2 u? N he said, no.
Then tha LORD opened tha eyes of Balaam, N he saw tha angel of tha LORD standin in tha way, N his sword drawn in his hand: N he bowed down his head, N fell flat on his face.
N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 him, so have u struck thine ass dese three times? look, I went out 2 withstand u, because ur way is perverse before me:
N tha ass saw me, N turned from me dese three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had killed u, N saved her alive.
N Balaam said 2 tha angel of tha LORD, I have sinned; 4 I knew not dat u stoodest in tha way against me: now therefore, if it displease u, I will get me back again.
N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 Balaam, Go wit tha men: but only tha word dat I shall speak 2 u, dat u will speak. So Balaam went wit tha princes of Balak.
N when Balak heard dat Balaam was come, he went out 2 meet him 2 a city of Moab, which is in tha border of Arnon, which is in tha utmost coast.
N Balak said 2 Balaam, Did I not earnestly send 2 u 2 call u? so came u not 2 me? am I not able indeed 2 promote u 2 honour?
N Balaam said 2 Balak, look, I am come 2 u: have I now any power at all 2 say any thing? tha word dat God puts in my mouth, dat shall I speak.
N Balaam went wit Balak, N dey came 2 Kirjath-huzoth.
N Balak offered oxen N sheep, N sent 2 Balaam, N 2 tha princes dat were wit him.
N it happened on tha morrow, dat Balak took Balaam, N brought him up in2 tha high places of Baal, dat thence he might see tha utmost part of tha people.

23.text: N Balaam said 2 Balak, Build me here seven altars, N prepare me here seven oxen N seven rams.
N Balak did as Balaam had spoken; N Balak N Balaam offered on every altar a bullock N a ram.
N Balaam said 2 Balak, Stand by ur burnt offering, N I will go: maybe tha LORD will come 2 meet me: N whatever he shows me I will tell u. N he went 2 an high place.
N God met Balaam: N he said 2 him, I have prepared seven altars, N I have offered upon every altar a bullock N a ram.
N tha LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, N said, Return 2 Balak, N like dis u will speak.
N he returned 2 him, N, look, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, N all tha princes of Moab.
N he took up his parable, N said, Balak tha king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of tha mountains of tha east, sayin, Come, curse me Jacob, N come, defy Israel.
How shall I curse, whom God has not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom tha LORD has not defied?
4 from tha top of tha rocks I see him, N from tha hills I look him: look, tha people shall live alone, N shall not be reckoned among tha nations.
Who can count tha dust of Jacob, N tha number of tha fourth part of Israel? Let me die tha death of tha righteous, N let my last end be like his!
N Balak said 2 Balaam, What have u done 2 me? I took u 2 curse mine opps, N, look, u have blessed ’em altogether.
N he answered, Must I not pay attention 2 speak dat which tha LORD has put in my mouth?
N Balak said 2 him, Come, I pray u, wit me 2 another place, from from where u may see ’em: u will see but tha utmost part of ’em, N will not see ’em all: N curse me ’em from thence.
N he brought him in2 tha field of Zophim, 2 tha top of Pisgah, N built seven altars, N offered a bullock N a ram on every altar.
N he said 2 Balak, Stand here by ur burnt offering, while I meet tha Lord yonder.

N he took up his parable, N said, Rise up, Balak, N hear; listen 2 me, u son of Zippor:

He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither has he seen perverseness in Israel: tha LORD his God is wit him, N tha shout of a king is among ’em.
God brought ’em out of Egypt; he has as it were tha strength of an unicorn.
Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according 2 dis time it shall be said of Jacob N of Israel, What has God wrought!
Look, tha people shall rise up as a great lion, N lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of tha prey, N drink tha blood of tha killed.
N Balak said 2 Balaam, Neither curse ’em at all, nor bless ’em at all.
But Balaam answered 2 Balak, Told not I u, sayin, All dat tha LORD speaks, dat I must do?
N Balak said 2 Balaam, Come, I pray u, I will bring u 2 another place; maybe it will please God dat u may curse me ’em from thence.
N Balak brought Balaam 2 tha top of Peor, dat looks toward Jeshimon.
N Balaam said 2 Balak, Build me here seven altars, N prepare me here seven bullocks N seven rams.
N Balak did as Balaam had said, N offered a bullock N a ram on every altar.

24.text: N when Balaam saw dat it pleased tha LORD 2 bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, 2 seek 4 enchantments, but he set his face toward tha wilderness.

N he took up his parable, N said, Balaam tha son of Beor has said, N tha man whose eyes r open has said:
He has said, which heard tha words of God, which saw tha vision of tha Almighty, fallin in2 a trance, but havin his eyes open:

As tha valleys r dey spread forth, as gardens by tha river’s side, as tha trees of lign aloes which tha LORD has planted, N as cedar trees beside tha waterz.
He shall pour tha water out of his buckets, N his seed shall be in many waterz, N his king shall be higher than Agag, N his kingdom shall be exalted.
God brought him forth out of Egypt; he has as it were tha strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up tha nations his opps, N shall break their bones, N pierce ’em through wit his arrows.
He couched, he lay down as a lion, N as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he dat blesses u, N cursed is he dat curses u.
N Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, N he struck his hands together: N Balak said 2 Balaam, I called u 2 curse mine opps, N, look, u have altogether blessed ’em dese three times.
Therefore now flee u 2 ur place: I thought 2 promote u 2 great honour; but, look, tha LORD has kept u back from honour.
N Balaam said 2 Balak, spoke I not also 2 ur messengers which u sentest 2 me, sayin,
If Balak would give me his house full of silver N gold, I cannot go beyond tha commandment of tha LORD, 2 do either good or bad of my own mind; but what tha LORD says, dat will I speak?
N now, look, I go 2 my people: come therefore, N I will advertise u what dis people shall do 2 ur people in tha latter days.
N he took up his parable, N said, Balaam tha son of Beor has said, N tha man whose eyes r open has said:
He has said, which heard tha words of God, N knew tha knowledge of tha most High, which saw tha vision of tha Almighty, fallin in2 a trance, but havin his eyes open:

I shall see him, but not now: I shall look him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, N a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, N shall strike tha corners of Moab, N destroy all tha children of Sheth.
N Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession 4 his opps; N Israel shall do valiantly.
Out of Jacob shall come he dat shall have dominion, N shall destroy him dat remains of tha city.
N when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, N said, Amalek was tha first of tha nations; but his latter end shall be dat he perish 4 ever.

Nevertheless tha Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry u away captive.
N he took up his parable, N said, Alas, who shall live when God does dis!

N Balaam rose up, N went N returned 2 his place: N Balak also went his way.

25.text: N Israel stayed in Shittim, N tha people began 2 commit whoredom wit tha daughters of Moab.

N, look, one of tha children of Israel came N brought 2 his brothers a Midianitish woman in tha sight of Moses, N in tha sight of all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, who were weepin before tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.

N he went after tha man of Israel in2 tha tent, N thrust both of ’em through, tha man of Israel, N tha woman through her belly. So tha plague was stayed from tha children of Israel.

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

So say, look, I give 2 him my covenant of peace:
N he shall have it, N his seed after him, even tha covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous 4 his God, N made an atonement 4 tha children of Israel.
Now tha name of tha Israelite dat was killed, even dat was killed wit tha Midianitish woman, was Zimri, tha son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among tha Simeonites.
N tha name of tha Midianitish woman dat was killed was Cozbi, tha daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, N of a chief house in Midian.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

26.text: N it happened after tha plague, dat tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Eleazar tha son of Aaron tha priest, sayin,

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
2 dese tha land shall be divided 4 an inheritance according 2 tha number of namez.

27.text: Then came tha daughters of Zelophehad, tha son of Hepher, tha son of Gilead, tha son of Machir, tha son of Manasseh, of tha families of Manasseh tha son of Joseph: N dese r tha namez of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, N Hoglah, N Milcah, N Tirzah.

N her father hear her vow, N her bond wherewith she has bound her soul, N her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, N every bond wherewith she has bound her soul shall stand.

But if her father disallow her in tha day dat he hears; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she has bound her soul, shall stand: N tha LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
N if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
N her husband heard it, N held his peace at her in tha day dat he heard it: then her vows shall stand, N her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

But if her husband disallowed her on tha day dat he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, N dat which she uttered wit her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: N tha LORD shall forgive her.
But every vow of a widow, N of her dat is divorced, wherewith dey have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
N if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond wit an oath;
N her husband heard it, N held his peace at her, N disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, N every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

But if her husband has utterly made ’em void on tha day he heard ’em; then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning tha bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband has made ’em void; N tha LORD shall forgive her.
Every vow, N every binding oath 2 afflict tha soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day 2 day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which r upon her: he confirmeth ’em, because he held his peace at her in tha day dat he heard ’em.
But if he shall any ways make ’em void after dat he has heard ’em; then he shall bear her iniquity.
Dese r tha statutes, which tha LORD commanded Moses, between a man N his wife, between tha father N his daughter, bein yet in her youth in her father’s house.

Only tha gold, N tha silver, tha brass, tha iron, tha tin, N tha lead,

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

N divide tha prey in2 two parts; between ’em dat took tha war upon ’em, who went out 2 battle, N between all tha congregation:

N of tha children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from tha men dat warred,

32.text: Now tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad had a very great crowd of cattle: N when dey saw tha land of Jazer, N tha land of Gilead, dat, look, tha place was a place 4 cattle;

N dey came near 2 him, N said, We will build sheepfolds here 4 our cattle, N citiez 4 our little ones:

N Moses said 2 ’em, If y’all will do dis thing, if y’all will go armed before tha LORD 2 war,

Defile not therefore tha land which y’all shall inhabit, in which I live: 4 I tha LORD live among tha children of Israel.

36.text: N tha chief fathers of tha families of tha children of Gilead, tha son of Machir, tha son of Manasseh, of tha families of tha sons of Joseph, came near, N spoke before Moses, N before tha princes, tha chief fathers of tha children of Israel:

N dey said, tha LORD commanded my lord 2 give tha land 4 an inheritance by lot 2 tha children of Israel: N my lord was commanded by tha LORD 2 give tha inheritance of Zelophehad our brother 2 his daughters.

N if dey be married 2 any of tha sons of tha other tribes of tha children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from tha inheritance of our fathers, N shall be put 2 tha inheritance of tha tribe whereunto dey r received: so shall it be taken from tha lot of our inheritance.

N when tha jubile of tha children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put 2 tha inheritance of tha tribe whereunto dey r received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from tha inheritance of tha tribe of our fathers.
N Moses commanded tha children of Israel according 2 tha word of tha LORD, sayin, tha tribe of tha sons of Joseph has said well.
Dis is tha thing which tha LORD does command concerning tha daughters of Zelophehad, sayin, Let ’em marry 2 whom dey think best; only 2 tha family of tha tribe of their father shall dey marry.
So shall not tha inheritance of tha children of Israel remove from tribe 2 tribe: 4 every one of tha children of Israel shall keep himself 2 tha inheritance of tha tribe of his fathers.

N every daughter, dat possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of tha children of Israel, shall be wife 2 one of tha family of tha tribe of her father, dat tha children of Israel may enjoy every man tha inheritance of his fathers.
Neither shall tha inheritance remove from one tribe 2 another tribe; but every one of tha tribes of tha children of Israel shall keep himself 2 his own inheritance.
Even as tha LORD commanded Moses, so did tha daughters of Zelophehad:
4 Mahlah, Tirzah, N Hoglah, N Milcah, N Noah, tha daughters of Zelophehad, were married 2 their father’s brothers’ sons:
N dey were married in2 tha families of tha sons of Manasseh tha son of Joseph, N their inheritance remained in tha tribe of tha family of their father.
Dese r tha commandments N tha judgments, which tha LORD commanded by tha hand of Moses 2 tha children of Israel in tha plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
